name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the continuation aligns with and is appropriate to the given context and preceding conversation.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is 'Not relevant at all' and 5 is 'Highly relevant'.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the ability of the continuation to maintain the interest of the reader and encourage further interaction.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is 'Not engaging at all' and 5 is 'Highly engaging'.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and consistency of the continuation with respect to the context and previous statements.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is 'Not coherent at all' and 5 is 'Highly coherent'.

name: Originality
description: Assesses how creative or novel the continuation is, considering the context and the interesting fact provided.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is 'Not original at all' and 5 is 'Highly original'.

name: Grammar and Syntax
description: Checks the grammatical correctness and syntactical clarity of the continuation.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is 'Poor grammar and syntax' and 5 is 'Excellent grammar and syntax'.
